MED:12934012.claim_de: Matsuo et al. berichten direkte circadiane Regulation der wee1-Expression und Kontrolle mitoserelevanter Cyclin-B1-Cdc2-Aktivität. CLOCK:BMAL1 wird im Abstract nicht ausdrücklich genannt; diese spezifische Zuordnung stammt hier nur aus Zou 2020, Zeile 49.

MED:12934012.quote_1: Here, we show in the regenerating liver (of mice) that the circadian clock controls the expression of cell cycle-related genes that in turn modulate the expression of active Cyclin B1-Cdc2 kinase, a key regulator of mitosis.
MED:12934012.quote_2: Among these genes, expression of wee1 was directly regulated by the molecular components of the circadian clockwork.
